_comment: Checked by hand against savronmn.com (home, booking pages for each barber, menu article, terms) and SAVRON booking schedules. Live sources in shops/savron.json win for any fact they return; this file fills the gaps. Barber hours and menus here come from the shop site, so they replace a third-party listing (Booksy).

facts.name: SAVRON Barbershop & Lounge
facts.cancellation_policy: Cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours in advance.
facts.membership: Leave your name and email. Members get a digital pass for Apple Wallet or Google Wallet that tracks visits.
facts.happy_hour: Happy Hour is 10 dollars off. The website does not list the days or times, so the team confirms them.
